# Header installation hardware and gaskets

## Summary

Inspect, flip unused stock manifold studs, replace them with new ones using an E10 external torx stud removal socket. [t2035]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Inspect the exhaust port on the back passenger side for unused studs.
2. [Partial] Remove and flip any stock manifold studs that are not in use to align with header holes.

_Procedure reported by [t2035]._

## Specifications

- **Stud removal socket type**: E10 external torx [t2035] ([Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- Replace every stud removed during installation with a new one. [t2035]
- [Partial] Purchase a complete set of studs and nuts from the dealership to ensure availability. [t2035]
